title: The Trump-Xi Summit Exposed the Problems in China-US Crisis Management
gist: Xi's September Washington visit produced no breakthrough on trade or AI safety, and conflicting readouts on a military crisis-communication memorandum exposed gaps in US-China crisis management.

insights.claim: China's readout said the two militaries agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding soon on crisis communication, but the White House fact sheet omitted it and a US official reportedly denied the discussion.
insights.speaker: Yang Jialin
insights.so_what: Unresolved military hotline commitment leaves accident-escalation risk unmanaged.
insights.quote: agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding as soon as possible on strengthening crisis communication and prevention

insights.claim: The Xi visit ended without major breakthroughs on trade or AI safety, and crisis management has gone largely undiscussed in coverage.
insights.speaker: Yang Jialin
insights.so_what: Limited deliverables mean limited reduction in policy risk.
